text: Allow yourself to want the “forbidden.” In the sphere of the second chakra are some of the strongest desires. Some of them are tabooed and pushed deep into the subconscious. But many desires are obvious, and people forbid them to themselves—touching another person, especially if you like them, showing your sensuality, attractiveness, sexuality. Even quality rest people can forbid themselves out of loyalty to the majority “earning their bread by the sweat of their brow”... Internal prohibitions create enormous tension both in the psyche and in the body. Become aware of and call into question at least some of those prohibitions that obviously manifest in your life. And I am not now suggesting that you overcome them. Simply allow yourself to want—this already partially removes the tension.
